description: This file defines the class JsonArrayAssert, which provides custom assertion methods for testing JsonArray objects within the project. It extends a base assertion class and utilizes AssertJ for fluent assertions.

classes.name: JsonArrayAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for JsonArray objects, providing methods to verify size, emptiness, array type, and containment of values.
